title: One AI Conversation Can Cost 500 Milliliters Of Water
hook: One AI conversation can cost 500 milliliters of water.
closing: Digital convenience still draws on physical water supplies shared with surrounding communities.
question: Should AI disclose its water cost?

segments.say: Microsoft's water use reached 6.4 million cubic meters, showing how thirsty large data centers became.
Google withdrew 21.2 million cubic meters, putting the physical scale of digital services into view.
One AI conversation can cost 500 milliliters of water, so millions of chats create a meaningful footprint.
